# EnKash

> EnKash is India's leading spend management and online payments platform, simplifying payments, corporate cards, expenses, vouchers, and rewards for businesses.

## Core Products

- [Payment Gateway](/payment-gateway): Robust online payment aggregator for credit cards, UPI, net banking, and EMI.
- [Payment Links](/payment-links): Generate and share unique links to collect customer payments instantly.
- [UPI Payments](/upi-payments): Simple, reliable, and secure UPI payment collection for businesses.
- [Corporate Cards](/products/corporate-cards): Commercial cards for business payments, travel, and meals.
- [Expense Management](/products/expense-management): Automate approvals, scan receipts, and manage budgets.
- [Vouchers](/products/vouchers): Digital vouchers for employee rewards and business gifts.

## For Developers

- [Developer Documentation](https://docs.enkash.com/): Official API reference, SDKs, and integration guides for EnKash Payment Gateway, prepaid cards, and expense management.
